reference: English Vocabulary Profile A1 (days, months); Cambridge A1 Starters/Movers-style spelling
matching: Items 1-2 write the next/previous day or month; 3-4 choice of correctly spelled form; EC = Arabic-L1 vowel/silent-letter spelling error (Wensday, Febuary, Tusday, Agust); FP = one sentence with a correctly spelled day or month; transfer = write a date/day from a calendar note. Matched by spelling difficulty (one silent-letter word + one long vowel per form), prompts 7-13 words. Review round 3: B-8/C-8 prompts no longer depend on climate (holiday month / month you like) and accept all 12 months like A-8; B-9/C-9 days changed to Friday/Saturday so the answer is not cued elsewhere in the form. Review round 4: the misspelled word in slots 5-6 now starts with a capital letter (Febuary, Tusday, Agust, Wensday, Septmber, Thersday), so each sentence has exactly one mistake, as the prompt says; the capital is still required in the answer. User decisions (A1-A2): vocabulary validity - each form keeps one spelling error-correction item (slot 5); slot 6 is now a meaning error (Arabic-L1 polysemy or calque on an A1 word), with exactly one correct fix and the answer word not shown elsewhere in the form. Fix of 2+ reviewer known issues: slot 6 is now a meaning error on a month word (Arabic numbered-month calque 'month five' -> May / June / October), tag lexical_l1_transfer; the month-word matchingNote now applies correctly.
